d:
Digha, Patna | In this interview with CPI-ML lone woman candidate DIvya Gautam in the ongoing Bihar elections, we spoke to her about the issues in her constituency, why is she the sole woman candidate from the Left party and why she thinks she can win in the constituency.
We also spoke to her about the question regarding there being no Muslim Deputy CM announcement by the Mahagathbandhan and about the Jungleraaj tag on RJD.
Watch this conversation and let us know what you think about it.
Anchor: Satyam
Camera: Abhishek
Video Edit: Aakash
